prompt: Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with whiplash after a rear-end collision. The patient had 18 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1147; do not mention it.)
text:
The patient presented following a rear-end motor vehicle collision with complaints of neck pain, stiffness, and headache radiating to the bilateral trapezius region. Cervical range of motion was restricted, particularly in extension and rotation, with paraspinal muscle tenderness and mild spasm noted on initial examination. Neurological screening revealed intact sensation and strength in the upper extremities with symmetric reflexes. A diagnosis of cervical strain consistent with whiplash-associated disorder was established.

Over the course of 18 visits, treatment consisted of manual therapy, soft tissue mobilization, progressive therapeutic exercise for cervical stabilization, and transitional home exercise instruction. Anti-inflammatory medication was used for symptom control as needed. Pain and range-of-motion measures improved steadily across the treatment period, with headache frequency decreasing and functional tolerance for daily activities and driving increasing.

At discharge, the patient reported residual intermittent neck stiffness with prolonged positioning but near-complete resolution of headaches. Cervical motion was improved though not fully symmetric. The patient was instructed to continue the home program and to return if symptoms worsen or new neurological signs develop.
